purpose: Plain-English first-time setup for gateway Web AI, direct provider APIs, and Local AI without changing Project authority.
display_lines: Config AI chooses how KANDA connects to an AI model. It does not choose the Active Project or grant file-writing permission.
Config Web AI supports the OpenRouter and Kilo gateways. Load a key when required, refresh the catalog, and select one approved [FREE] Python-coding model.
Direct API Providers supports Google Gemini, Mistral, Qwen, and Groq through their official APIs.
Use Key / Load Environment uses a pasted key when the field contains text; when the field is empty it loads the provider's Windows User or process environment variable.
Keys are masked and session-only. Do not paste an API key into a question, screenshot, source file, or Project document.
The Direct API Free access guard is only your confirmation. It does not inspect or change provider billing.
Gemini requires an unbilled Free Tier project; Mistral requires Free mode; Qwen requires remaining free quota with Free Quota Only; Groq requires a Free Plan organization.
A 429 quota or rate-limit response means the request reached the provider but the current allowance was exhausted.
Config Local AI expects a running OpenAI-compatible local endpoint, commonly http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 for Ollama.
KANDA does not install, start, or download Local AI models. Start the runtime first, then Refresh Local AI Models and select one model.
After remote setup, open Web AI > Web Advisory Config and select Access, Provider, and Python model before using Project Conversation.
Always confirm the Active Project, privacy notice, credential status, catalog status, and selected model before an important request.
The full rich Help page contains step-by-step setup, environment-variable names, provider guidance, troubleshooting, and illustrated examples.
